name: SEOBOT
description: AI agent for SEO — keywords, research, blog, mini apps, pSEO — from John Rush's stable. ~$49/mo.

mentions.evidence: ~$39.1k MRR, 538 active subscriptions, ~$39.8k L30, ~$1.88M all-time, ~200k users claimed, founded Sep 2023. Last sync Sep 30, 2026.
mentions.indieAngle: Autopilot content for a specific channel (SEO/AEO) with clear $49 packaging — productized agency energy without the retainer chaos.

whyItPrints: Founders still buy "write and publish SEO content for me." Recurring content ops on Stripe with a long all-time trail. (Promoted from Sep 28 honorable mention with fresh sync.)
whyThisMatters:
Founders use SEOBOT when they want a blog and don't want to hire an SEO person. It finds keywords, writes the article, adds links and images, and can refresh older posts. There's a public monthly price to start. It can also build programmatic pages, chase backlinks, write news posts, and ship small tools.

Articles are aimed at about 3,000 words. A YouTube video can become a post. They run a fact-check and a pass that tries to catch made-up claims. Once a month it can re-link what's already published. It posts to WordPress, Webflow, Ghost, Framer, Wix, Shopify, Notion, HubSpot, or Next.js, or through a webhook. More than 50 languages are supported. It's one of John Rush's products, started in September 2023.

They say it has created more than 200,000 articles. A companion offer called ListingBott is aimed at domain rating. You subscribe so the research, the draft, and the publish step happen while you build the product.
